name: Multi-query attention
change: All query heads share a single key and value head.
problem_solved: Cuts KV bytes per token by the number of heads, which speeds up memory-bound decoding.
trade_off: One K/V head for all queries can lose quality and make training less stable; GQA was introduced as a middle ground.

reference.title: Fast Transformer Decoding: One Write-Head is All You Need
